user.title: Set up a bed sleep tracker
user.description: Pick the accelerometer on your bed and the sleep window. The integration analyses the acceleration itself: every night it detects the movements inside the window and scores the night from 0 to 100 when the window ends.

data_description.name: Used for the device and as the prefix of the entity IDs.
data_description.accelerometer_sensors: The acceleration axes of the bed sensor (X, Y and Z, in m/s²), or a single sensor that already holds the acceleration magnitude.
data_description.presence_entity: If set, the night is scored only when this entity is home/on, so an empty bed is not mistaken for a perfect night.
data_description.window_start: Movements are counted from this time. Can be changed later from the card or the device page.
data_description.window_end: The night is scored at this time.

error.sensor_count: Select from one to three sensors.
error.window_empty: Start and end must be different.

data_description.accelerometer_sensors: The acceleration axes of the bed sensor (X, Y and Z, in m/s²), or a single sensor that already holds the acceleration magnitude.
data_description.presence_entity: If set, the night is scored only when this entity is home/on, so an empty bed is not mistaken for a perfect night.
data_description.movement_threshold: Agitation (rolling standard deviation of the acceleration, m/s²) above which a movement is detected. Lower it if movements are missed, raise it if too many are counted. The calm and intensity scales follow this value.

error.sensor_count: Select from one to three sensors.

entry_not_found.message: No Bed Sleep Score entry with ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: {name} is not loaded: enable it or fix its setup, then try again.

set_score.name: Set score
set_score.description: Sets the score of the last night and, optionally, the 7-day average. Useful when migrating from another setup: the values are kept across restarts, and the next window is scored as usual.

config_entry_id.name: Sleep tracker
config_entry_id.description: The Bed Sleep Score entry to update.

average.name: 7-day average
average.description: Optional. Starting value of the 7-day average, 0-100. If omitted, the average is not changed.

night_of.name: Night of
night_of.description: Optional. Date of the morning the night ended. Default: today.
